lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: counterexamples and why a proof fails
lessonRef.title: Targeted correction: counterexamples and why a proof fails

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Each example contains the correction, not just the answer.

items.prompt: A parallelogram has an angle of 110°. Find the consecutive angle.
Third side is 18. Find the midsegment.

steps: Midsegment is half the third side.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Before solving, say which error the problem is testing for.

items.prompt: A proof concludes that base angles of an isosceles triangle are congruent, after constructing the bisector of the apex angle. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: The two smaller triangles are congruent by SAS, so their corresponding base angles are congruent.
All triangles have congruent base angles.
The base angles look equal in the diagram.
The bisector is perpendicular to the base by definition.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 29°. Find the measure of the alternate interior angle.
In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 37° and 22°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
In a parallelogram, one angle measures 81°. Find the consecutive angle.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: In a triangle, a segment joins the midpoints of two sides. The third side measures 58. Find the length of the midsegment and state its relationship to the third side.
choices: 29, and it is parallel to the third side
29, and it is perpendicular to the third side
116, and it is parallel to the third side
58, and it is parallel to the third side

items.prompt: A proof concludes that vertical angles are congruent. Which statement supplies the missing justification?
choices: Vertical angles are congruent by definition.
The angles are congruent because they are opposite in position.
The two lines are parallel, forcing the angles to match.
Each vertical angle is supplementary to the same adjacent angle, so both have the same measure.

items.prompt: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle measures 60°. Find the measure of the corresponding angle.
In a triangle, the two remote interior angles measure 20° and 29°. Find the exterior angle at the third vertex.
